open.ask: Does the application revisit a sample within one pass over the set (a draw with replacement), or touch each exactly once per pass (a permutation)?

at_scale.measure: share of the set never read; share of touches that re-read a path

open.question: selection
open.settles: a second pass over the set (a repeat decides it), or the corpus size: fewer than 2 candidates refutes a draw with replacement (no repeat in 2 touches would have probability below 0.05)

open.ask: Is the number of bytes read from a file a property of the file (its size), or chosen per access?

at_scale.note: the op multiset is the same in distribution; which file gets which bytes differs

open.question: size
open.settles: a repeat of a path: the same bytes again is a size per path, other bytes a draw per open

open.ask: Within a pass, does the application take the files in their sorted order, or in a shuffled one?

at_scale.note: the op multiset is the same; the order within a pass differs, which read-ahead sees

open.question: order
open.settles: at least 8 consecutive touches within one pass
